permissionName.foundation:users:lock: Lock or unlock a user account
permissionName.production:production_orders:start: Start or resume a production order
permissionName.quality:quality_checks:close: Close a check with a result
permissionName.quality:ncr_reports:cancel: Cancel a report or a corrective action
permissionName.quality:specifications:create: Create a specification or a revision
permissionName.masterdata:products:update: Edit a product and its template
permissionName.workforce:members:link_user: Link a member to a user

permissionDescription.foundation:organization:read: Shows the organization's profile and basic details.
permissionDescription.foundation:organization:update: Edits the organization's name, address, contacts and time zone.
permissionDescription.foundation:organization:branding: Uploads or removes the organization's logo.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:read: Shows the users and their details.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:write: Creates user accounts and edits their details.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:deactivate: Stops the user signing in; the account and its history stay.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:delete: Deletes an account that was never activated and has no business references.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:lock: Locks an account for a while, or unlocks it.
permissionDescription.foundation:users:reset_password: Sets a new password for a user.
permissionDescription.foundation:roles:read: Shows the roles and their permissions.
permissionDescription.foundation:roles:write: Creates custom roles, edits or deletes them.
permissionDescription.foundation:user_roles:write: Gives a role to a user or removes it.
permissionDescription.foundation:role_permissions:write: Adds a permission to a role or removes it, with its scope.
permissionDescription.foundation:security_log:read: Shows sign-in attempts and security events.
permissionDescription.foundation:activity_log:read: Shows what users did in the system.
permissionDescription.foundation:activity_log:archive: Downloads the archive of months past their 12-month retention, then deletes them; is told when one is due.
permissionDescription.foundation:delegations:read: Shows every approval delegation of the organization and its state.
permissionDescription.foundation:delegations:manage: Approves or rejects delegation requests, delegates on a holder's behalf (with their agreement) and revokes any delegation.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:read: Shows the complaint register, each complaint and its decision history; own customers only at scope «own».
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:create: Registers a new complaint as the customer made it, with its products and quantities.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:update: Records contact with the customer and internal follow-ups, links records, attaches evidence and edits the product lines.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:assign: Sets the complaint's owner, the handling department and the resolution date; the first assignment starts the processing.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:investigate: Records the finding, the measured values, the confirmed affected quantity and containment, and refers to quality.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:resolve: Records the resolution, its evidence and the customer's response, and requests closure.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:close: Approves the closure of a complaint or returns it for processing.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:reopen: Reopens a closed complaint with a stated reason.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:cancel: Cancels a complaint registered by mistake, with the reason.
permissionDescription.commercial:complaints:report: Produces the complaint register and the detailed complaint report.
permissionDescription.commercial:customers:read: Shows customers and their details (only their own when the scope is "own").
permissionDescription.commercial:customers:update: Edits a customer's details, status and relationship stage.
permissionDescription.commercial:customers:delete: Deletes a customer with no quotations or orders.
permissionDescription.commercial:customers:assign_owner: Sets or moves a customer's sales owner, one or many.
permissionDescription.commercial:interactions:read: Shows the recorded calls, visits and messages.
permissionDescription.commercial:interactions:create: Records a call, visit or message.
permissionDescription.commercial:interactions:delete: Deletes an interaction recorded by mistake (unless a follow-up came from it).
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:create: Creates a follow-up task with a customer.
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:update: Edits a follow-up's date and details.
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:assign: Assigns a follow-up, or moves one person's follow-ups to another.
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:complete: Records a follow-up as done, with its outcome.
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:read: Shows sample requests (for their own customers only when the scope is "own").
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:update: Edits the product, specification and quantity before delivery.
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:delete: Deletes a sample request with no quotations.
permissionDescription.commercial:evaluations:create: Records the sample's evaluation result and next step.
permissionDescription.commercial:evaluations:update: Corrects a recorded evaluation's result or notes.
permissionDescription.commercial:evaluations:delete: Deletes an evaluation recorded by mistake.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:read: Shows quotations and their documents (for their own customers only when the scope is "own").
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:create: Creates a new quotation as a draft.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:update: Edits a draft quotation's lines and prices.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:delete: Deletes a quotation that is not accepted and has no orders.
permissionDescription.commercial:quote_settings:read: Shows the document language, signature and terms.
permissionDescription.commercial:quote_settings:update: Edits the document language, signature and terms.
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:read: Shows sales orders (for their own customers only when the scope is "own").
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:create: Creates a draft sales order, direct or from an accepted quotation.
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:update: Edits a draft order's lines and quantities.
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:delete: Deletes a draft order that was never confirmed.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:issue: Sends the quotation to the customer and locks it.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:accept: Records that the customer accepted; the quotation becomes final.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:reject: Records the customer's rejection with the reason.
permissionDescription.commercial:quotes:revise: Takes the quotation back to a draft as a new revision, with the reason.
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:confirm: Confirms the order; its lines, quantities and specifications lock.
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:cancel: Cancels the order with the reason (before production).
permissionDescription.commercial:orders:revise: Takes a confirmed order back to a draft as a new revision (before production).
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:start: Moves a sample to in preparation.
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:deliver: Records that the sample reached the customer.
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:reopen: Puts a sample back to requested.
permissionDescription.commercial:samples:decide: Records the customer's decision on the sample (accept, reject, modify).
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:cancel: Cancels a follow-up no longer needed.
permissionDescription.commercial:follow_ups:reopen: Reopens a completed or cancelled follow-up.
permissionDescription.production:work_centers:update: Edits a work center's details and capacity.
permissionDescription.production:shifts:update: Edits a shift's times and details.
permissionDescription.production:shift_rosters:read: Shows the crews on each shift.
permissionDescription.production:shift_rosters:create: Creates a crew roster for a shift.
permissionDescription.production:shift_rosters:update: Edits or replaces a shift roster.
permissionDescription.production:shift_rosters:manage_members: Adds workers to a roster or removes them.
permissionDescription.production:shift_rosters:close: Closes a roster so it no longer changes.
permissionDescription.production:demands:read: Shows production demands and their status.
permissionDescription.production:demands:create: Creates a production demand, from a confirmed sales order or by hand.
permissionDescription.production:demands:update: Edits a demand and its lines before planning.
permissionDescription.production:demands:release: Makes a demand ready for planning, or takes it back to a draft.
permissionDescription.production:demands:cancel: Cancels a demand; its quantity returns to the sales order.
permissionDescription.production:planning:sequence: Changes the order of the planning queue.
permissionDescription.production:planning:allocate: Allocates demand quantities to a production order.
permissionDescription.production:planning:release_allocation: Gives an allocated quantity back to its demand, with the reason.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:read: Shows production orders and their details.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:update: Edits a production order's dates and details.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:manage_item: Adds, edits or removes the order's items.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:create: Creates a production order from planning.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:release: Releases the order for the floor.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:start: Starts the order, or resumes it after a hold.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:hold: Puts the order on hold, with the reason.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:complete: Records that the order's production is done.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:close: Closes the order after its result is confirmed.
permissionDescription.production:production_orders:cancel: Cancels the order, with the reason.
permissionDescription.production:runs:read: Shows production runs and their crews.
permissionDescription.production:runs:create: Creates a run for a production order.
permissionDescription.production:runs:cancel: Cancels the run, with the reason.
permissionDescription.production:runs:manage_members: Adds or removes workers, or loads them from the roster.
permissionDescription.production:results:create: Records the produced quantity and scrap.
permissionDescription.production:results:update: Edits a recorded result before closing.
permissionDescription.production:results:delete: Deletes a recorded result before closing.
permissionDescription.production:results:correct: Records a documented correction to a closed order's result.
permissionDescription.production:downtime_events:read: Shows machine stops and their causes.
permissionDescription.production:downtime_events:create: Records a machine stop and its cause.
permissionDescription.production:downtime_events:delete: Deletes a downtime event recorded by mistake.
permissionDescription.production:downtime_events:close: Records that the machine runs again.
permissionDescription.production:waste_records:create: Records a scrap quantity and its cause.
permissionDescription.production:waste_records:delete: Deletes a scrap record made by mistake.
permissionDescription.quality:settings:update: Edits certificate numbering and quality settings.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_checks:create: Opens a check for a production order, a receipt or a return.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_checks:update: Edits a check before it closes.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_checks:start: Starts the inspection and fixes its plan.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_checks:close: Sets the check's result and accepted and rejected quantities.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_checks:cancel: Cancels the check, with the reason.
permissionDescription.quality:rejections:read: Shows rejected quantities and their decisions.
permissionDescription.quality:rejections:update: Edits a rejection before its decision.
permissionDescription.quality:rejections:decide: Decides rework, scrap or use with a concession.
permissionDescription.quality:rejections:execute: Records that the decision was carried out.
permissionDescription.quality:quality_defects:create: Records a defect in a check.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:read: Shows the reports and their actions.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:update: Edits the report, its items and its corrective actions.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:verify: Judges the actions' effectiveness and closes the report.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:cancel: Cancels the report or one of its actions, with the reason.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:investigate: Records the investigation and root cause.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_reports:submit: Sends the report for verification once its actions are done.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_actions:read: Shows the actions assigned to their department.
permissionDescription.quality:ncr_actions:complete: Records an action as done, with evidence.
permissionDescription.quality:specifications:read: Shows technical specifications and test limits.
permissionDescription.quality:specifications:create: Creates a draft specification or a new revision of one.
permissionDescription.quality:specifications:update: Edits a draft specification and its limits.
permissionDescription.quality:specifications:activate: Puts the revision in force in place of the previous one.
permissionDescription.quality:certificates:read: Shows the certificates and their versions.
permissionDescription.quality:certificates:create: Creates a draft certificate, or a replacement for an issued one.
permissionDescription.quality:certificates:issue: Approves and numbers the certificate; it becomes final.
permissionDescription.quality:certificates:revoke: Revokes an issued certificate (also needed to issue a replacement).
permissionDescription.shipping:directory:read: Shows the registered drivers, vehicles and carriers.
permissionDescription.shipping:directory:write: Adds, edits and deactivates drivers, vehicles and carriers.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:update: Edits the shipment's lines and details.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:dispatch: Records the goods leaving, with the gate weight.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:deliver: Records the customer's receipt, in full or in part, and the proof of delivery.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:cancel: Cancels the shipment before it leaves.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:ready: Marks the shipment ready to leave.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:reopen: Takes a ready shipment back to a draft.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:reschedule: Changes the dispatch or delivery date.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:fail: Records that the customer did not receive the goods and they come back.
permissionDescription.shipping:shipments:close: Closes a note whose goods came back undelivered.
permissionDescription.shipping:returns:create: Registers a return against a delivery note.
permissionDescription.shipping:returns:cancel: Withdraws the return before it is received.
permissionDescription.shipping:returns:reject: Refuses the customer's return, with the reason.
permissionDescription.shipping:settings:update: Edits delivery note numbering and settings.
permissionDescription.procurement:suppliers:approve: Approves a supplier, puts it on probation, or blocks it.
permissionDescription.procurement:materials:update: Edits a material and its inspection requirement.
permissionDescription.procurement:receipts:update: Edits a receipt's lines before confirming.
permissionDescription.procurement:receipts:receive: Confirms the materials arrived; the receipt becomes final.
permissionDescription.procurement:receipts:cancel: Cancels the receipt, with the reason.
permissionDescription.procurement:settings:update: Edits document numbering and purchase terms.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:read: Shows purchase orders and their documents.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:update: Edits the order's lines and prices before approval.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:approve: Approves the order before it goes to the supplier.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:cancel: Cancels the order, with the reason.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:send: Records that the approved order went to the supplier.
permissionDescription.procurement:purchase_orders:close: Closes an order that expects nothing more.
permissionDescription.masterdata:products:read: Shows products and their templates, to choose from.
permissionDescription.masterdata:products:create: Adds a product and its specification template.
permissionDescription.masterdata:products:update: Renames a product, changes its template, or deactivates it.
permissionDescription.masterdata:products:map_legacy: Rewrites an old product type in every record to a defined product.
permissionDescription.masterdata:settings:read: Shows the VAT rate and default currency.
permissionDescription.masterdata:settings:update: Edits the VAT rate and default currency.
permissionDescription.masterdata:lists:read: Shows sectors, opportunity sources, countries and cities.
permissionDescription.masterdata:lists:update: Adds, edits or deactivates list items.
permissionDescription.masterdata:lists:map_legacy: Rewrites an old value in every record to a list item.
permissionDescription.workforce:members:update: Edits a member's details and status.
permissionDescription.workforce:members:link_user: Links a member to a sign-in account, or unlinks it.
permissionDescription.notifications:announcements:send: Writes a message or announcement to named users, a role's members or the whole organization, and follows who read and acknowledged it.
permissionDescription.notifications:announcements:manage: Follows every announcement of the organization and who read it, and withdraws any announcement.
permissionDescription.organization:branding:read: Shows the identity printed on documents.
permissionDescription.organization:branding:update: Edits the names, addresses, bank accounts and logo printed on documents.
permissionDescription.reports:production:order_full: Prints the full production order report.
permissionDescription.reports:production:orders_summary: Prints a summary of production orders for a period.
permissionDescription.reports:production:results_analysis: Prints the analysis of output and scrap.
permissionDescription.reports:production:shift_workforce: Prints the crews on each shift.
permissionDescription.reports:customers:directory: Prints the customer list and details.
permissionDescription.reports:customers:quotations_report: Prints quotations and outcomes for a period.
permissionDescription.reports:customers:demand_fulfillment: Prints the status and allocation of customers' demands.
permissionDescription.reports:customers:customer_statement: Prints the customer's orders and their status.
permissionDescription.reports:customers:internal_audience: Prints customer reports with internal data (for management).
permissionDescription.reports:quality:checks_summary: Prints a summary of checks for a period.
permissionDescription.reports:quality:rejections_analysis: Prints the analysis of rejections and decisions.
permissionDescription.reports:quality:defects_analysis: Prints the analysis of defects and their frequency.
permissionDescription.reports:quality:corrective_actions: Prints corrective actions' status and due dates.

ReturnsQualityStatus.not_required: Back in stock (not sent to quality).
ReturnsQualityStatus.awaiting: Waiting for quality to inspect the goods.
ReturnsQualityStatus.decided: Quality decided; some parts are still being carried out.
